title: Style Lock
description: Machine-readable visual contract. After Gate 4 (Style Locked), READ-ONLY for the rest of the pipeline. Web Renderer (7B) and Image Renderer (7A) MUST re-read this before every page.

usage.description: Where this color is used: background, headline, body, accent, divider, ...

color_palette.description: Optional extended palette. primary/accent/background above are the required minimum set.

font_heading.description: CSS font-stack string for headings. Must end with a cross-platform fallback (e.g. 'Inter, "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif').

font_body.description: CSS font-stack string for body text.

font_size_anchor.description: Pixel sizes anchored to body. Other sizes derive as ratios.

image_style.description: Single phrase describing the deck-wide image rendering style, e.g. 'clean educational diagram', 'editorial collage', 'hand-drawn sketch with watercolor'. Read by Image Renderer on every page. Pulled from assets/style-presets/<style_name>.json.image_style_description.

image_palette.description: Optional deck-wide image palette name, e.g. 'cool-corporate', 'warm-earth'. Defaults to deriving from primary/accent/background.

density.description: Information density per page. Drives bullet count limits and whitespace.

layout_bias.description: Optional. Default selection by style_name; override only when intentional.

icon_stroke_width.description: Required only when icon_library is stroke-style (tabler-outline, lucide).

page_rhythm.description: Per-page rhythm map keyed by page_id (P01, P02, ...). Borrowed from ppt-master. Empty = default 'dense' for all pages.

forbidden.description: Hard constraints. Each entry is a natural-language rule, e.g. '不要一上来讲 Agent', '禁止页面塞满文字', 'No marketing CTAs'. Both Writer (content) and Style Guard (visual) consult this list.

hex.description: CSS hex color. 3, 6, or 8 hex digits (8 allows alpha).
